items.question: What is the difference between normative political theory and empirical work in political science?
items.answer: Normative political theory focuses on what should happen and how the world should be organized, dealing with ideals and prescriptive theories. In contrast, empirical work in political science examines how things are actually organized in reality, relying on data and historical context to analyze political phenomena.
